confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel rates, which vary by district, season and lead time. Cocktail and wine_glass are set relative to the beer anchor since direct knowledge of Beijing bar and wine-by-the-glass prices is limited. FX 0.7002 (14 Oct 2026) came from a search summary of RBA data that a follow-up search could not confirm; the RBA table was not read directly, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Chinese tier-1 cities such as Shanghai, adjusted for Beijing's domestic restaurant, hostel and hotel price levels; no live prices were checked.
